name: Teploy CLI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free open-source CLI for SSH-based zero-downtime Docker deployments on your own server; automatic rollback, Caddy HTTPS, multi-server support, previews and configuration-based deploys.
watch_out: The CLI and related open-source tools have no Teploy subscription, account or usage meter, but require your own servers, Docker/SSH infrastructure and operational management. Teploy Cloud is a separate paid managed offering; comply with the applicable MIT/AGPL license.
